name: kensigline
description: Kensigline: API (backend) + React UI (frontend). Run from repo root.

scripts.postinstall: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,ui -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix backend && npm run build --prefix frontend
scripts.test: npm test --prefix backend && npm run test:integrity
scripts.start: npm run build && concurrently -k -n api,ui -c cyan,magenta "npm run start --prefix backend" "npm run preview --prefix frontend -- --host 127.0.0.1 --port 5173"
scripts.test:integrity: node --import ./backend/node_modules/tsx/dist/loader.mjs --test backend/src/performance/cohort.test.ts backend/src/shared/ingest-retention.test.ts backend/src/performance/calculate.test.ts backend/src/performance/daily.test.ts backend/src/core/disclosure-bulk-prices.test.ts backend/src/core/senate-parse.test.ts backend/src/investigate/politicians/oge-278t-parse.test.ts backend/src/core/cors.test.ts backend/src/tracker/outcomes.test.ts backend/src/investigate/institutions/parse-13f.test.ts backend/src/billing/membership-owner.test.ts backend/src/billing/webhook-delivery.test.ts backend/src/core/statement-timeout.test.ts backend/src/core/filing-date.test.ts backend/src/core/ai-runtime.test.ts backend/src/investigate/politicians/house-ptr-parse.test.ts frontend/src/disclosureReturn.test.js frontend/src/routePath.test.js && node --experimental-vm-modules --test frontend/src/exploreApi.test.js
